'''2015 Texas Mini Worlds Jan Westergard DS Endor Operations''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Jan Westergard]] at [[2015 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).


== Deck info ==

* '''Player:''' [[Jan Westergard]]
* '''Event:''' [[2015 Texas Mini Worlds]]
* '''Side:''' [[Dark]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Endor Operations / Imperial Outpost|Endor-D-endoroperations.gif}}
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:Open EOps Westergard DS 2015 TMW.txt |Download]]
* '''Format:''' [[Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
* '''Source:''' [https://www.starwarsccg.org/2015-texas-mini-worlds/ PC list]. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261013130941/https://swccg.com/snapshots/pc/2015-texas-mini-worlds.html Internet Archive]
